title: Repo-wide Version Suffix And Legacy Code Cleanup
description: Remove all versioned/legacy/migration code across the monorepo: delete dead legacy-format bridges, migrate fixtures off old shapes, strip V1 suffix from types and /v1 from schema strings.
summary: Fixed sequence canvas usability issues reported after DAG abstraction: (1) Completed flow-style catalogue drag-drop parity in sequence/react — ghost step preview via setGhostStep/clearGhostStep WASM, pointer palette drag, drag-over client sync, preview/escape bridges, window pointerup drop commit. (2) Hid triangle execution port text labels (prev/next) in dag label overlay so node names dominate. (3) Repaint triangle execution handles after node bodies so pins stay visible at Normal LOD. All sequence_core, mathematical_graph_port_directed_dag, dag-react, and sequence-react tests pass.
